name: Built In Chicago

sources.title: Built In Chicago homepage — Chicago tech hub of Built In; 'Join'/'Log In', company profiles, 'For Employers' flows

conditions: Company profiles are for tech companies/employers in the Chicago market — claiming/creating a profile requires an employer account on the Built In platform
The knowledgebase claim article (knowledgebase.builtin.com/s/article/How-do-I-claim-my-company-profile) rendered only a CSS-error shell during research — the exact claim flow is unverified
requirements: A real technology company with a Chicago (or Built In hub city) presence — Built In profiles companies as employers (jobs, benefits, tech stack), not standalone products
The site is a regional skin of builtin.com — 'BuiltIn.com is the global destination for tech professionals'; account flows are shared with the parent platform
preparation: Official company email/domain to claim or create the employer profile
Company assets: logo, description, jobs feed, tech stack, benefits info
Check whether a company page already exists under builtinchicago.org (or builtin.com/company/<slug>) before creating a new one
workflow: Open https://builtinchicago.org/ and use 'Join' to create an account, or search the companies directory for an existing company page
If a profile exists, claim it via the employer/company claim flow (per Built In knowledgebase; verify in a real browser — the KB page failed to render to automated fetch)
Complete the profile (logo, description, jobs) and publish
Optionally explore 'For Employers / Post a Job' paid packages for visibility
watchFor: Employer branding on Built In has paid tiers — the free claim may be limited in features/visibility
Profiles are employer-centric; a product without a hiring company behind it is a poor fit
knowledgebase.builtin.com did not render during research — do not assume the exact claim steps without browser verification
Duplicate submission risk: this hub shares builtin.com's company database — do not create a second listing if the builtin.com playbook was already executed
countsAsLive: A public company profile page exists on builtinchicago.org (or builtin.com/company/<slug>) showing the company's logo, description, and links
unknowns: Whether a fully free claim tier exists vs paid employer packages
Whether profile website links are follow or nofollow
Whether a company can appear on multiple Built In city hubs from one claim
